relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Once sensitized, nociceptors release CGRP and substance P [9,37,50,52], which induce vasodilation, vascular permeability, immune cell recruitment, and mast cell degranulation

key_findings: Narrative review proposes a mast cell-TRPV1-CGRP neuroimmune axis shared by endometriosis (direct evidence) and lipedema (hypothetical).
Pain amplification is proposed to depend on network sensitization rather than lesion burden.
